reason: On the Recipients screen the bulk bar wraps each button in a div with tabindex 0, so the first Tab stop on Request tax docs is that wrapper, where Enter and Space do nothing. The next Tab reaches the real button, and Enter opens the Request tax documents dialog with focus inside it, so keyboard users can open it.

Tab onto the Send on field opens the calendar popover on focus alone, so Enter and Space have nothing left to open. The sweep read a popover that was already open as not opened. I did not press Enter in the field because it sits in the payment form.

On Needs Approval, Tab reaches the first row and Enter moves focus to Close detail panel while the panel stays hidden (aria-hidden true, opacity 0, shifted 200px), and Space does nothing, so the detail panel opens only with a mouse click. Ticking the row checkbox with Space and activating Review Request opens the full review page with Approve and Decline, so an equivalent keyboard path exists but is hard to find.

On both parent screens, Tab onto the Name combobox opens the customer list on focus (aria-expanded true, Add new customer and the customer options visible), so there is no separate Enter or Space step. The sweep counted only a list that opened after its keypress.

On Edit Filing the bulk bar wraps Done in a div with tabindex 0, so the first Tab stop is that wrapper, where Enter and Space do nothing. The next Tab reaches the real Done button, and Enter opens the payee drawer with focus on its Close detail panel button, so keyboard users can open it.
